Recompute cosine_steps from the shorter warmup; keep eta_min=lr*0.01, AdamW, weight_decay, label_smoothing, and architecture unchanged
Update training manifest metadata (warmup_fraction, warmup_start_factor) for auditability
success_criteria: pytest passes; training pipeline completes and writes checkpoint manifest
